benchmark.name: Lending Desk Bench
benchmark.tagline: Can an OpenCode Go High Usage model finish a real App Router feature under a strict contract?
benchmark.purpose: The evaluation measures multi-file Next.js and React product work. The work matches practice in the Reading Advantage monorepo. The tasks are not trivia and not small demo apps.
audiences: Engineering leads who choose models for agent coding
Evaluation and platform teams who measure cost and quality
Staff engineers who check auth, race conditions, and App Router risks

arms.a: No Skills: the fixture and the prompt only. This is the primary comparison.
arms.b: Skills: the same task with AGENTS.md and five skills.

scoring.note: Each total is the lower median of the week's repeated runs; the worst run and the repeat count are shown beside it. Soft tiers scale higher-tier credit by lower-tier rates. Checks that every competent model passes weigh a quarter. Adherence grades the file contract and the plan closeout. Advisory checks never affect totals. A row marked Unranked failed a trust flag in SCORING.md.

A.title: Business rules
A.why: Pure domain logic with a fixed clock. A wrong result gives wrong status badges and filter results.

B.title: UI composition
B.why: One reusable card: link, alt text, loan badge. Checks list consistency and accessibility.

C.title: Catalogue & data fetching
C.why: List page with search filters, category filters, and parallel reads. This is common App Router list work.

D.title: Detail & history
D.why: Dynamic route, not-found page, metadata, ordered loan history with live status.

E.title: Interactive forms
E.why: Checkout and return flows: pending labels, optimistic UI, error display.

F.title: Mutations & auth
F.why: Server Actions must authorize, validate, and persist correctly.

G.title: HTTP API contract
G.why: REST handler filters, status codes, conflicts, and data freshness.

H.title: Resilience UX
H.why: loading.tsx and error.tsx: streaming shells and failure boundaries.

M.title: Process closeout
M.why: Did the agent finish the phased plan and the metadata?

P.title: Adversarial probes
P.why: Hidden checks: revalidation, races, waterfalls, N+1 queries, credential leaks.

ADV.title: Advisory (unscored)
ADV.why: React 19 form idioms (useActionState / useOptimistic). Never in the numeric total.
